newsitem.title: CANADA: Early close recommended for Canadian bond market.
newsitem.headline: Early close recommended for Canadian bond market.

text.p: The Toronto Bond Traders' Association said it is recommending that dealings in the Canadian bond market end early at 1400 EDT/1800 GMT on Friday.
"The Toronto Bond Traders' Association recommends a two o'clock closing today," said Jeremy Fleming, a trader at TD Securities Inc and secretary of the association.
Canadian financial markets will be closed on Monday for Labour Day.
